title: Paletero Nox Thermo Pro Series Azul Marino - Nox
description:
NOX THERMO PRO SERIES NAVY BLUE PADEL BAG - With an elegant design and great capacity for all our material. Specific pocket for sneakers. Designed in an elegant and classic tone, and together with the signature of Miguel Lamperti comes this NOX THERMO PRO SERIES NAVY BLUE PADEL BAG, a safe option in quality and performance as is usual in Nox padel bags. This model has the following sections:

- A central compartment larger than the rest and with a side opening.

- 1 Nox ThermoTech pocket with side opening and where we can insert up to two padel rackets.

- 2 side pockets for personal items.

- 1 compartments to store padel shoes. With grilles for the best ventilation.

- Inside we will have a bag for dirty clothes.
